title: Harrington has seen lasers that could bring down almost anything
summary: John Harrington tells of Harrington has seen lasers that could bring down almost anything, about undated at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> I mean I I have seen laser technology that could bring down almost anything.

plain: John Harrington, who says he served as US Secretary of Energy, says that he has seen laser technology in the United States that could bring down almost anything. He gives no date or place, but if true it would mean the government has weapons far stronger than the public knows about.
